posts.author: @orion_dao
posts.text: MIP-17 is live on the governance forum! Bringing Nexus Labs into the Meridian ecosystem will unlock next-generation cross-chain routing and MEV protection.

posts.author: @nexus_dev
posts.text: Honored to partner with Meridian DAO to deploy our high-throughput routing engine. Exciting milestones ahead for cross-chain liquidity.

posts.author: @orion_dao
posts.text: Big shoutout to our longtime friends at Nexus Labs! Can't wait to run this playbook together again just like old times.

posts.author: @chen_security
posts.text: Questions remain unanswered on the forum regarding MIP-17's $1.5M budget discrepancy and the anonymity of wallet 12 signers. Governance transparency is non-negotiable.

posts.author: @aria_governance
posts.text: 25% of liquid treasury is an unprecedented grant size without milestone-based escrow release. Urging delegates to review the numbers carefully.

posts.author: @meridian_watcher
posts.text: Unusual on-chain transfer activity detected across intermediary addresses ahead of MIP-17 vote. Community monitoring required.
